$ claude-sessions config --claude-dir <CLAUDE> set-machine LAP-2
exit 0
--- stdout
This machine is now known as LAP-2 (saved in <CLAUDE>/session-sync.json).
It was LAP-1. Run `claude-sessions push`, then `claude-sessions machines --forget LAP-1`
so the archive does not keep listing the old name as another machine.
--- stderr
